prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes because each kind has only one test so far.
Reordering sign-in was the only change with a winning test (sign_in, reorder), though evidence remains thin.
Redesigning the home screen (home, redesign) made onboarding worse, and adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) triggered a guardrail rollback.
No clear effect was seen for hint changes (finish, hint and home, hint), copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), or adoption wait info widgets (adoption, wait_info).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, wait_info: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Playground Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a centered interactive playground preview while pet generation completes in the background. (why: The home (waiting) step has a median duration of 201s (mean 2336s). Providing an interactive layout reduces perceived wait time and lowers drop-offs.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen: Add a dedicated screen right before home intro that confirms the pet renders visibly on the user's desktop screen. (why: Support received 3 bug emails about pets failing to show on the desktop screen or the app failing to open at the home stage.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Structured Photo Upload Flow: Transform photo upload into a multi-step checklist flow with guidelines for custom pet creation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% dropoff rate and 1017s mean completion time, plus 3 support reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
3: [home, notification] Pet Ready Desktop Notification: Add a desktop system notification toggle and time estimate on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend a median of 201s on the waiting screen; notifications allow users to multitask safely without abandoning onboarding.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidelines Hint: Add photo selection quality guidelines and visual badge hints to the photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, causing user frustration during adoption.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Timer: Display an active progress bar and estimated time remaining indicator during pet generation. (why: Users wait median 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen without clear feedback on remaining generation time.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Pet Persistence Copy Clarification: Update sign-in headline and body text to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves pet data across sessions. (why: The top support theme last week was missing or reset pets after signing in again (8 support emails).)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Mascot Welcome Incentive: Add a playful animated mascot component to the initial story screen welcoming users to the app. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of starting users right at the beginning of the onboarding funnel.)
8: [finish, layout] Final Intro Spotlight Layout: Switch the home intro screen layout to spotlight view focused directly on launching the desktop pet. (why: The finish step drops off to 64.8% conversion with a median time of 395s, showing hesitation at the final onboarding screen.)
